name: NORMA Group SE
summary: NORMA Group SE, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells engineered joining technology solutions in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Americas, and the Asia-Pacific. The company provides quick connectors, pipe clamps, plastic connectors, retain and fix solutions. It sells its products to distributors, specialized wholesalers, smaller industrial sectors, original equipment manufacturers, doit-yourself stores under the ABA, Breeze, Clamp-All, CONNECTORS, Gemi, NORMA, R.G.RAY, Serflex, and TORCA brand names.
